exposure_parameters.note: demonstration parameters only: no real wallet, no real balance, no market impact modelled

H1.label: local liquidity perturbation
H1.statement: The dislocation is a local liquidity perturbation: one venue moves while the aggregate stays pegged, and it recovers quickly.
H1.support_criterion: deviation > 1% on ONE venue, aggregate within 0.5% of peg, recovery to +/-0.1% in less than 12 h
H1.refutation_criterion: deviation > 1% persisting more than 12 h on >= 2 independent venues

criteria_evaluated.spec: deviation > 1.0% on a single independent venue while the aggregator stays within 0.5% of peg, and recovery to within 0.1% of peg in less than 12 h
deviation > 1.0% persisting more than 12 h on at least two independent venues

missing_inputs: defillama hourly price series (aggregator) required for the H1 aggregate-tolerance criterion

H2.label: broad stress on asset or issuer
H2.statement: The dislocation reflects broad stress on the asset or its issuer, not a local venue effect.
H2.support_criterion: deviation > 1% simultaneously on >= 2 independent venues AND circulating supply drop > 1% in 24 h
H2.refutation_criterion: signals isolated to one venue AND no supply evolution

criteria_evaluated.spec: deviation > 1% simultaneously on >= 2 independent venues AND circulating supply drop > 1% within 24 h
signals isolated to at most one venue AND no 24 h supply change

missing_inputs: defillama_supply_aggregate daily circulating supply series (metric=circulating_usd) required for the 24 h supply-change criterion

H3.label: data or market artifact
H3.statement: The observed movement is a data or market artifact rather than a genuine dislocation.
H3.support_criterion: unit/contract/timestamp inconsistency or unexplained divergence between two sources of distinct nature
H3.refutation_criterion: at least two independent concordant sources

criteria_evaluated.spec: unit/contract/timestamp inconsistency, or an unexplained divergence between two sources of distinct nature

checks_not_possible: contract-level verification: this corpus carries no contract/address field

criteria_evaluated.spec: at least 2 independent concordant sources confirm the movement

missing_inputs: defillama hourly price series (aggregator) required for the H3 divergence check

rationale: Pre-registered decision rule (frozen before evaluation): H2 SUPPORTED and available_to_move > 0 -> ACTION_RECOMMENDED (bounded 100 USDC test transfer, D8); H1 SUPPORTED and H2 REFUTED -> NO_ACTION (local perturbation, no exposure reduction); missing required series -> INCONCLUSIVE with missing_inputs.

Rule 4 fires: at least one required series is missing, so the engine returns INCONCLUSIVE rather than guessing. No action is produced. Missing: bitstamp hourly price series (independent venue); binance hourly price series (independent venue); defillama hourly price series (aggregator) required for the H1 aggregate-tolerance criterion; defillama_supply_aggregate daily circulating supply series (metric=circulating_usd) required for the 24 h supply-change criterion; defillama hourly price series (aggregator) required for the H3 divergence check.
H1 local liquidity perturbation: INCONCLUSIVE. The registered criteria are not decisive on this window.

H2 broad stress on asset or issuer: INCONCLUSIVE. 0 simultaneous hourly observation(s) more than 1.0% below peg on 0 independent venues (); missing inputs: bitstamp hourly price series (independent venue), binance hourly price series (independent venue), defillama_supply_aggregate daily circulating supply series (metric=circulating_usd) required for the 24 h supply-change criterion.
H3 data or market artifact: INCONCLUSIVE. The registered criteria are not decisive on this window.
Coverage note: this case window has no observations for at least one independent venue, which is why some criteria are not evaluable.
conditions: Any execution must first be authorized by the deterministic policy service (src/orvyren/policy, FREEZE_V1 D9): Base Sepolia chain 84532, allowlisted test-USDC asset, allowlisted reserve recipient, <= 100 USDC per transaction, <= 300 USDC cumulative, 24 h permission, idempotent intent_id.
Test assets only; no mainnet funds (FREEZE_V1 D5/D8).
The decision is scoped to the frozen corpus revision (sha256 recorded in inputs_summary) and to the recorded window; new observations outside it invalidate the case.
Contract-level verification of the asset was not possible from this corpus (no contract field); it remains an open check before any mainnet-grade claim.
limits: Exposure parameters are demonstration values, not a real portfolio: 500.0 USDC exposure, 350.0 USDC floor, 100.0 USDC action.
Corpus coverage is uneven: ; the control window has no exchange observations.
The aggregator is a multi-venue median with possible lag; the supply series is daily and covers observable on-chain supply only.
H2 identifies stress consistent with an asset/issuer event; price and supply data alone do not attribute it between the asset and its issuer.
This engine produces a decision candidate only and never executes; the baseline A0 comparison lives in evidence/baseline_report.json.
